title: Babel Babel Babble
style: 95 bpm, phonk funk, lo-fi swagger, female lead seductive melodic, male low rap response, babble bot vocal copies, sidechained sub bass, vinyl crackle, EN Spanish blend, booth-cabin energy, late night
lyrics:
[Intro - Female, seductive melodic over phonk hats]
Meet me in the booth, meet me in the sound
Babel babel babble — lay that rhythm down

[Babble Bots - soft copy]
Lay that rhythm down... babel babel babble...

[Verse 1 - Male, low phonk swagger]
Don't want your typed-out proof, don't need your alibi
Everybody brave online till the beat asks who and why
I came in through the side door, lights moving slow
Babble bots en la cabina, ready for the show
This ain't comments, this a coded tone
Babel babel babble — the booth is home

[Female Response - Spanish]
Muévelo, déjalo arder
Si vas a hablar, hazlo sonar bien
Babel babel babble — en la cabina hoy
Ponlo en la canción — así me voy

[Pre-Chorus - Female lead]
No feed war, no long explainers
No fake saints, no dopamine chasers
Just hook, verse, bass, truth
Babel babel babble — that's the proof

[Chorus - Female lead, Male backing, Bots layered]
Babble bots in the background
Copy what we say
Babel babel babble — carry it away
No comments on the timeline
No fingers on the phone
If you wanna send a feeling
Put that feeling in the song

[Post-Chorus - Bots chant]
In the song — in the song
Ponlo en la canción
Babel babel babble — in the song

[Verse 2 - Female, phonk groove]
I don't need a perfect line
I need the crack inside your voice
That little human break of time
That says this rhythm was a choice
Babble bots en la cabina, faders to the red
If the feeling's real enough, let the chorus say it instead

[Bridge - Male spoken, Female ad-libs]
Male: You want the message clear? Don't type to me. Sing to me.
Female: Cántamelo — sin miedo — cántamelo de verdad
Male: No caption, no defense. Just the record.

[Final Chorus - all voices layered]
Babble bots in the background
Now they lead the wave
Babel babel babble — only songs that say we're brave
Ponlo en la canción — ponlo en la canción
If you mean it, make it strong — put that feeling in the song

[Outro - Female + Bots fade]
Meet me in the signal, meet me in the sound
Solo canciones, babel babel babble down
Three thirty six — in the song
